author: Yote Hunter
notes_extra: 135 gr Classic Hunter. 0.010 off the lands. 2.25 in group at 500 yards. He named the 6.5x47 Lapua on March 10 in the same thread. 26 in barrel.

author: rpierce
notes_extra: A customer's lighter 6.5x47 that rpierce built. 135 grain Classic Hunter, 0.020 off the lands. 0.247 in three-shot group at 200 yards. The customer reported softball-size exits on deer neck shots.

author: CTK
notes_extra: 135 Classic Hunter. Groups in the 0.2s. He wrote a 23 ft barrel mark; the length is 23 in. He said he has 0.2 gr left until the Berger max. Loading for hunting. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6.5x47.

author: Yote Hunter
notes_extra: 135 gr Berger Classic Hunter. 26 in Krieger 8.5 twist. 1.1 in five-shot group at 500 yards. He named the powder in the following post the same day.

author: Welldone 7.5
notes_extra: 135 grain Classic Hunter. He found the most stable velocity at this charge. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6.5 Creedmoor.

author: bradb
notes_extra: 135 classics. Creed carbon Broughton barrel. 0.918 in at 500 yards. He wrote creed. The thread is 6.5 Creedmoor.
